tools.description: Scan a directory and compute all metrics. Must be called before other tools. Returns quality_signal.

path.description: Absolute path to the directory to scan

tools.name: scan

tools.description: Re-scan the current directory to pick up file changes since last scan.
tools.name: rescan

tools.description: Save current health metrics as baseline for later comparison via 'gate' or 'session_end'.
tools.name: session_start

tools.description: Re-scan and compare current state against session baseline. Returns diff showing what degraded.
tools.name: session_end

tools.description: Get quality signal (0-1) with root cause breakdown (modularity, acyclicity, depth, equality, redundancy). Quality signal = geometric mean — maximize this ONE number.
tools.name: health

tools.description: Check .sentrux/rules.toml architectural constraints. Returns pass/fail with specific violations.
tools.name: check_rules

tools.description: Git history analysis: code churn, hotspots (churn x complexity), bus factor, change coupling. Raw data — not a score. Requires git history.
tools.name: git_stats

tools.description: Get the Design Structure Matrix: NxN dependency matrix showing file relationships, clusters, and inversions.

format.description: Output format: 'text' for ASCII matrix, 'stats' for summary statistics (default: stats)

tools.name: dsm

tools.description: Find high-risk source files with zero test coverage. Cross-references test file detection with import graph and complexity.
tools.name: test_gaps
